source: Hamamatsu Photonics annual securities report: FY2025 (12-18-2025)

players.product: Optical sensors for optical transceivers in data-center high-speed optical communications

quarterly_data.quarter: Hamamatsu Photonics annual securities report: FY2025 (12-18-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended September 30, 2025 (October 2024 - September 2025): net sales JPY 212,051 million (up 4.0%), operating profit JPY 16,163 million (down 49.7%), ordinary profit JPY 18,802 million (down 45.5%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 14,203 million (down 43.5%). Management states sales and profit fell short of the third-year targets of the three-year plan announced in November 2022, as orders fell when the semiconductor industry and others entered an inventory adjustment phase in reaction to the surge in advance ordering that began with COVID-19, and fixed costs such as depreciation from capital investment weighed relatively more
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 212,051 million (+4.0%); operating profit JPY 16,163 million (-49.7%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Hamamatsu Photonics annual securities report: FY2025 (12-18-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 Opto-semiconductor segment: sales JPY 79,505 million (up 1.7%), operating profit JPY 12,583 million (down 29.7%). Sales of image sensors for semiconductor manufacturing and inspection equipment rose, driven by demand for high-performance semiconductors for generative AI and data centers, while silicon photodiodes for X-ray CT and flat panel sensors for dental diagnostic equipment fell, partly on price competition in China and high interest rates in Europe and the US
quarterly_data.figure: Opto-semiconductor sales JPY 79,505 million (+1.7%); operating profit JPY 12,583 million (-29.7%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Hamamatsu Photonics annual securities report: FY2025 (12-18-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 Electron Tube segment: sales JPY 71,906 million (down 7.4%), operating profit JPY 18,953 million (down 20.4%). Deuterium lamps for analytical instruments such as liquid chromatographs rose, but photomultiplier tubes for specimen-testing equipment fell as US National Institutes of Health (NIH) budget cuts reduced investment, and microfocus X-ray sources for non-destructive inspection of lithium-ion batteries fell on the stagnant EV market
quarterly_data.figure: Electron Tube sales JPY 71,906 million (-7.4%); operating profit JPY 18,953 million (-20.4%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Hamamatsu Photonics annual securities report: FY2025 (12-18-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 Imaging and Measurement Instruments segment: sales JPY 32,703 million (down 0.1%), operating profit JPY 9,698 million (down 6.9%); semiconductor failure analysis systems rose on expanding investment in high-performance semiconductors for generative AI, pathology digital slide scanners were firm, and digital camera demand fell on budget cuts in bio. Laser segment: sales JPY 22,255 million (up 107.7%), operating loss JPY 4,365 million (prior-year loss JPY 204 million); sales of stealth dicing engines that cut silicon wafers rose with strong generative-AI capital investment, while costs such as goodwill amortization from the acquisition also increased
quarterly_data.figure: Imaging JPY 32,703 million (-0.1%); Laser sales JPY 22,255 million (+107.7%), operating loss JPY 4,365 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Hamamatsu Photonics annual securities report: FY2025 (12-18-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 production by segment (at selling prices): Electron Tube JPY 75,054 million (up 1.4%), Opto-semiconductor JPY 74,346 million (down 3.1%), Imaging and Measurement Instruments JPY 27,799 million (up 2.7%), Laser JPY 20,395 million (up 60.4%), total JPY 201,674 million (up 3.0%). The company mainly produces to forecast, so no orders-received figures are reported. No customer accounted for 10% or more of net sales, so no major customer is disclosed
quarterly_data.figure: Production JPY 201,674 million (+3.0%); no customer at 10% or more of sales

quarterly_data.quarter: Hamamatsu Photonics annual securities report: FY2025 (12-18-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 sales by customer location: Japan JPY 47,866 million, US JPY 51,243 million, Europe JPY 49,551 million (of which Germany JPY 21,519 million), Asia JPY 62,943 million (of which China JPY 40,689 million), other JPY 446 million. The company estimates the effect of a 1-yen move on annual operating profit at JPY 300 million for the US dollar, JPY 100 million for the euro and JPY 1,000 million for the Chinese yuan
quarterly_data.figure: China sales JPY 40,689 million; Asia JPY 62,943 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Hamamatsu Photonics annual securities report: FY2025 (12-18-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 capital investment of JPY 34,819 million (property, plant and equipment received basis), mainly to expand production capacity and strengthen development: Opto-semiconductor JPY 18,877 million, including construction of a building to expand opto-semiconductor production capacity and development; Imaging JPY 3,073 million; Electron Tube JPY 1,776 million; Laser JPY 1,144 million; corporate JPY 2,124 million. Research and development expenses rose JPY 4,887 million (36.0%), to 8.7% of net sales; total R&D JPY 18,439 million
quarterly_data.figure: Capex JPY 34,819 million (Opto-semiconductor JPY 18,877 million); R&D JPY 18,439 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Hamamatsu Photonics annual securities report: FY2025 (12-18-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Planned new facilities (plan to end-September 2026; start October 2025, completion September 2026): factory and manufacturing equipment for opto-semiconductor devices, budget JPY 47,924 million (JPY 27,024 million already paid); Electron Tube factory and equipment JPY 5,410 million; semiconductor laser factory and equipment (Laser) JPY 3,626 million; Imaging manufacturing equipment JPY 1,200 million; Beijing Hamamatsu Photon Techniques factory and equipment JPY 2,210 million; corporate basic-R&D equipment, a second quality measurement building and an anechoic chamber JPY 2,400 million; total JPY 62,770 million (JPY 30,470 million paid)
quarterly_data.figure: Planned capex JPY 62,770 million; Opto-semiconductor JPY 47,924 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Hamamatsu Photonics annual securities report: FY2025 (12-18-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D: the company was solely selected for a NEDO project on industrializing quantum computers (fiscal 2025-2027) to further develop core devices for quantum computers such as ultra-high-speed cameras, multi-pixel high-sensitivity cameras and multi-pixel spatial light modulators; it offers LCOS-SLM spatial light phase modulators used for optical tweezers and, through subsidiary NKT Photonics, lasers with stable wavelength, intensity and phase for quantum computing

quarterly_data.quarter: Hamamatsu Photonics annual securities report: FY2025 (12-18-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D: released the NanoZoomer S540 virtual slide scanner for research use, a high-end model that holds up to 540 glass slides, with improved AI recognition of tissue and cells; the company aims to obtain medical device status in Japan and overseas

quarterly_data.quarter: Hamamatsu Photonics annual securities report: FY2025 (12-18-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Management states that, given possible supply chain disruption and cost increases from US-led reciprocal tariffs and heightened geopolitical risk, the group maintains its policy of domestic production for many products while studying a review of production sites for some products and optimizing inventory
